title: BM25 Text Search Pipeline, Id Tracker Memory, Formula Expressions and v1.20 SDK Syncs
mini_srs: This milestone delivers the full BM25 text search pipeline for qdrant spanning the explicit Disabled stemmer variant (08a73b5) the TextQuery type in the Query API (8a5566c) text index scoring parameters (8d788c9) per-scorer BM25 parameter nesting (b381478) counts-only term frequency scoring without positions (b051def) and cross-shard BM25 merging via TextScoringInternal in the internal gRPC protocol (e70ee32). It extends unified memory placement to the point id tracker component with cached placement support (9614dc0 333ca00) and adds acosh max and min operators to formula expressions (fe27f6a aba9516 f8acc7c). The Rust client sync (0dca5bf) introduces TextQueryBuilder and IdTrackerParamsBuilder while the Python client v1.20 sync (3247b10) regenerates all gRPC stubs and REST models. Path completeness requires 12 intermediate commits (v1.19 SDK syncs local mode fixes Turbo16) on DAG paths between qdrant contract seeds and SDK mega-syncs; these overlap with G02 G03 G05 G06 G08 and will be resolved in consolidation.
